Maharashtra FDA Bans Loose Milk Sales, Restricts Drug Sales

The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has banned the sale of loose milk across the state, mandating that only sealed and labelled milk products can be sold. In a separate action, the FDA also barred the sale of certain drugs from Cadila Pharmaceuticals due to brand confusion. These measures aim to ensure product quality and consumer safety.
